          October Gallery is delighted to present the second solo exhibition of <a href="/artists/LRVandy">LR Vandy</a>, following last year’s display of her large-scale installation, <em>Dancing in Time: The Ties That Bind Us</em>, a five-meter-high rope sculpture commissioned for the International Slavery Museum’s Martin Luther King celebrations at Liverpool’s Canning Dock waterfront. <em>Twist</em> features a new series of sculptures created from a variety of ropes and other materials; one large-scale rope work, several smaller rope sculptures, a collection of photographic prints and further new works from the artist’s signature <em>Hull</em> series.
<br><br>
In 2022, Vandy relocated her studio to a site adjacent to the Ropery at Chatham Historic Dock Yard – an establishment which has preserved traditional rope-making, still using original machinery from the 19th century, of which the oldest dates back to 1811. This led the artist to explore the matter and properties of rope, as she began to delve into the material’s historical importance and symbolic implications. Used, from ancient times, in constructions of all kinds, rope became essential to the burgeoning maritime industry, thereby becoming inextricably involved in the building of empires and the colonial history of slavery. By binding, sewing and manipulating her materials, Vandy celebrates rope’s versatility while still alluding to and playfully subverting its many historical associations.
<br><br>
This series of rope sculptures was inspired by Barbara Ehrenreich’s book, ‘Dancing in the streets’, which locates the phenomenon of ‘collective joy’ as central to the origins of dance. Other contributing sources can be found in hunting rituals and the African spirit dances that transformed into carnival masquerades in the African diaspora. Vandy’s vivacious curvilinear sculptures challenge the typical representation of the female form –historically subjected to the male gaze – to provide a more positive depiction that associates female abstraction with empowerment. Works such as <em>Dynamo Woman</em>, explore similar territory. Vandy engineered giant sculptures made of a wide strip of spiralling copper – the element central to the electro-dynamic revolution that powered the later industrial age – which besides representing tornado-like guardian spirits symbolise the vital energy of the female form. In her rope ‘figures’ the strength and supple flexibility of the twined materials extend this idea by evoking suggestions of the ‘Grain Mother’ deity figure, the harvest guardian, who represents continuity and the survival of humanity. These ancestral and atavistic themes manifest in the large-scale ‘Rope Mother’ figure, which acts both as template for and energetic focus of the smaller dancing rope works that surround her. The vital, energetic forms are composed by shaping and hand-sewing sections of rope together, before tying off and binding the loose ends with twine or copper wire. Other rope sculptures subtly integrate incongruous found objects: cogs, pipes, washers skipping-rope handles, etc. While the title given to each playful sculpture names a particular dance, taken altogether, the twisting, twirling forms appear as freeze-frame captured moments of a single gyrating body dancing to the movement of time.
<br><br>
Alongside these sculptures, a new selection of Vandy’s striking <em>Hull</em> series will be shown, exploring the trade significance of indigo. The artist draws upon traditional talismans, amulets and charms to transform these model boats into ‘masks’ adorned and animated with various materials including rope, fishing floats and feathers. By creatively combining both found and handcrafted objects; by continuously experimenting with different materials; and by striking unanticipated echoes from these never-before-seen forms, LR Vandy’s remarkable assemblages, on close examination, animate the field of contemporary sculpture with haunting echoes laden with insight into issues of continuing relevance today.

<script>
(function() {
    var CART_ADD_URL = '/shop/index.php?route=checkout/cart.add&language=en-gb';
    var CHECKOUT_URL = '/og-shop/?checkout';
    var toastEl = null;
    var toastTimer = null;
    var addedPids = {};
    try { addedPids = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('og_cart_pids') || '{}'); } catch(e) {}

    function persistAdded() {
        try { sessionStorage.setItem('og_cart_pids', JSON.stringify(addedPids)); } catch(e) {}
    }

    // Fast-checkout text link under "Added ✓" — shown on the MOST-RECENTLY-added
    // card only (session-scoped, matching the /og-shop grid).
    function removeGridCheckout() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.store-grid-checkout').forEach(function(el) { el.remove(); });
    }
    function showGridCheckout(container) {
        removeGridCheckout();
        if (!container) return;
        var link = document.createElement('a');
        link.className = 'store-grid-checkout';
        link.href = CHECKOUT_URL;
        link.innerHTML = 'Checkout →';
        container.appendChild(link);
    }

    function showToast(message, duration) {
        duration = duration || 4000;
        if (!toastEl) {
            toastEl = document.createElement('div');
            toastEl.className = 'og-toast';
            document.body.appendChild(toastEl);
        }
        toastEl.innerHTML = message;
        toastEl.className = 'og-toast';
        void toastEl.offsetWidth;
        toastEl.classList.add('visible');
        clearTimeout(toastTimer);
        toastTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            toastEl.classList.remove('visible');
        }, duration);
    }

    // Apply persisted state on load
    document.querySelectorAll('.store-grid-cart-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
        var pid = btn.getAttribute('data-product-id');
        if (addedPids[pid]) {
            btn.textContent = 'Added \u2713';
            btn.classList.add('added');
        }
    });
    // Quick-PDF persisted state (preserve the PDF icon)
    document.querySelectorAll('.store-quick-pdf-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
        var pid = btn.getAttribute('data-product-id');
        if (addedPids[pid]) {
            btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf"></i> Added <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>';
            btn.classList.add('added');
        }
    });

    // Update price label when format select changes (and refresh "Added" state for new pid)
    document.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
        var sel = e.target.closest('.store-format-select');
        if (!sel) return;
        var cardId = sel.getAttribute('data-card-id');
        var opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
        if (opt && opt.dataset.price) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-card-price-for="' + cardId + '"]').forEach(function(el) {
                el.textContent = '£' + opt.dataset.price;
            });
        }
        // Refresh button "Added" indicator for the now-selected variant
        var article = sel.closest('article');
        var btn = article ? article.querySelector('.store-grid-cart-btn') : null;
        if (btn) {
            var newPid = sel.value;
            if (addedPids[newPid]) {
                btn.textContent = 'Added \u2713';
                btn.classList.add('added');
            } else {
                btn.textContent = 'Add to Cart';
                btn.classList.remove('added');
            }
        }
    });

    // Quick-buy PDF shortcut — uses the button's own data-product-id (skip format-select override)
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var quickBtn = e.target.closest('.store-quick-pdf-btn');
        if (!quickBtn || quickBtn.classList.contains('added')) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        var pid = quickBtn.getAttribute('data-product-id');
        quickBtn.textContent = 'Adding...';
        var fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('product_id', pid);
        fd.append('quantity', '1');
        fetch(CART_ADD_URL, { method: 'POST', body: fd, credentials: 'include' })
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function() {
                quickBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf"></i> Added <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>';
                quickBtn.classList.add('added');
                addedPids[pid] = true;
                persistAdded();
                showGridCheckout(quickBtn.closest('.store-grid-add-cart'));
                showToast('<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> PDF added to cart <a href="/og-shop/?cart">View Cart</a>');
                var cc = document.getElementById('cart-count');
                if (cc) {
                    var m = cc.textContent.match(/\d+/);
                    var n = m ? parseInt(m[0]) + 1 : 1;
                    cc.textContent = '(' + n + ' item' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ')';
                    cc.style.display = 'inline';
                }
            })
            .catch(function() {
                quickBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf"></i> Buy PDF';
                showToast('Could not add to cart. Please try again.');
            });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var btn = e.target.closest('.store-grid-cart-btn');
        if (!btn || btn.classList.contains('added')) return;
        // Prefer the format select's value if the card has one
        var article = btn.closest('article');
        var sel = article ? article.querySelector('.store-format-select') : null;
        var pid = sel ? sel.value : btn.getAttribute('data-product-id');
        btn.textContent = 'Adding...';
        var fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('product_id', pid);
        fd.append('quantity', '1');
        fetch(CART_ADD_URL, { method: 'POST', body: fd, credentials: 'include' })
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function() {
                btn.textContent = 'Added \u2713';
                btn.classList.add('added');
                addedPids[pid] = true;
                persistAdded();
                showGridCheckout(btn.closest('.store-grid-add-cart'));
                showToast('<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Added to cart <a href="/og-shop/?cart">View Cart</a>');
                var cc = document.getElementById('cart-count');
                if (cc) {
                    var m = cc.textContent.match(/\d+/);
                    var n = m ? parseInt(m[0]) + 1 : 1;
                    cc.textContent = '(' + n + ' item' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ')';
                    cc.style.display = 'inline';
                }
            })
            .catch(function() {
                btn.textContent = 'Add to Cart';
                showToast('Could not add to cart. Please try again.');
            });
    });
})();

        const currentSize = url.match(/-(\d+x\d+)\.(\w+)$/);

            const ext = currentSize[2];
            const basePath = url.replace(/-\d+x\d+\.\w+$/, '');
            const currentIndex = previewConfig.fallbackSizes.indexOf(currentSize[1]);

            if (currentIndex < previewConfig.fallbackSizes.length - 1) {
                const nextSize = previewConfig.fallbackSizes[currentIndex + 1];

                linkElement.href = fallbackUrl;
                tryImageWithFallback(fallbackUrl, linkElement);
            } else {
                linkElement.click();
            }
        }
    };

}

        var controller = new AbortController();
        var timer = setTimeout(function() { controller.abort(); }, timeoutMs || FETCH_TIMEOUT);
        options = options || {};
        options.signal = controller.signal;
        return fetch(url, options).then(function(res) {

        document.querySelectorAll('a.store-preview-image').forEach(function(el) {
            var cap = el.getAttribute('data-strip-caption');
            if (!cap) return;
            cap = cap.replace('class="store-cart-tally"', 'class="store-cart-tally active"');
            cap = cap.replace(
                /<span class="store-cart-badge-count">\d+<\/span>/,
                '<span class="store-cart-badge-count">' + count + '<\/span>'
            );
            cap = cap.replace(
                /<span class="store-cart-badge-text">[^<]*<\/span>/,
                '<span class="store-cart-badge-text">' + itemText + '<\/span>'
            );
            el.setAttribute('data-strip-caption', cap);
        });
    }

    // ---- Cart tally (pre-baked in caption HTML, toggled via .active class) ----

    function updateAllTallies() {
        var count = miniCartState.cartCount;
        document.querySelectorAll('.store-cart-tally.active').forEach(function(tally) {
            if (count === 0) {
                tally.classList.remove('active');
                return;
            }
            var countEl = tally.querySelector('.store-cart-badge-count');
            if (countEl) countEl.textContent = count;
            var textEl = tally.querySelector('.store-cart-badge-text');
            if (textEl) textEl.textContent = ' item' + (count !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' in cart';
        });
    }

    function hideAllTallies() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.store-cart-tally.active').forEach(function(tally) {
            tally.classList.remove('active');
        });
    }

    // Update the header cart count (#cart-count in top-extras bar)
    // Can accept pre-fetched HTML to avoid duplicate request
    function refreshHeaderBadge(html) {
        if (html) {
            _updateBadgeFromHtml(html);
            return;
        }
        fetchWithTimeout(CART_INFO_URL + '&t=' + Date.now(), { credentials: 'include', cache: 'no-store' })
            .then(function(res) { return res.text(); })
            .then(function(h) { _updateBadgeFromHtml(h); })
            .catch(function(err) { console.warn('Store: header badge fetch failed', err.message); });
    }

    function _updateBadgeFromHtml(html) {
        var match = html.match(/(\d+)\s*item/i);
        var badge = document.getElementById('cart-count');
        if (badge && match) {
            var n = parseInt(match[1]);
            badge.textContent = '(' + n + ' item' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ')';
            badge.style.display = 'inline';
        }
    }

    // ---- Caption poll (no dependency on .strp-caption — queries elements directly) ----

    function startCaptionPoll() {
        if (miniCartState.pollId) return;
        var idleTicks = 0;

        miniCartState.pollId = setInterval(function() {
            if (miniCartState.cartCount === 0) { stopCaptionPoll(); return; }
            var didWork = false;

            // Activate any inactive tallies in the document
            document.querySelectorAll('.store-cart-tally:not(.active)').forEach(function(tally) {
                tally.classList.add('active');
                var countEl = tally.querySelector('.store-cart-badge-count');
                if (countEl) countEl.textContent = miniCartState.cartCount;
                var textEl = tally.querySelector('.store-cart-badge-text');
                if (textEl) textEl.textContent = ' item' + (miniCartState.cartCount !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' in cart';
                didWork = true;
            });

            // Enforce "Added ✓" on any buttons Strip.js may have re-created
            for (var pid in addedProductIds) {
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    '.store-lightbox-actions[data-product-id="' + pid + '"] .store-btn-add-cart:not(.store-btn-added)'
                ).forEach(function(btn) {
                    btn.style.transition = 'none';
                    btn.classList.remove('store-btn-add-cart');
                    btn.classList.add('store-btn-added');
                    btn.textContent = 'Added \u2713';
                    btn.style.backgroundColor = '#2e7d32';
                    didWork = true;
                });
            }

            if (!didWork) {
                idleTicks++;
                if (idleTicks > 200) stopCaptionPoll();
            } else {
                idleTicks = 0;
            }
        }, 200);
    }

    function stopCaptionPoll() {
        if (miniCartState.pollId) {
            clearInterval(miniCartState.pollId);
            miniCartState.pollId = null;
        }
    }

    // ---- Page load: pre-fetch cart ----

    fetchCart().then(function(cartData) {
        if (cartData.items.length > 0) {
            miniCartState.cartCount = countCartItems(cartData);
            activateTallyInAllTriggers();
            refreshHeaderBadge(cartData._raw);
        }
    }).catch(function(err) {
        console.warn('Store: page-load cart fetch failed', err.message);
    });

    // Start badge poll when store lightbox opens
    document.addEventListener('store-lightbox-open', function() {
        if (miniCartState.cartCount > 0) {
            startCaptionPoll();
        }
    });

    // ---- Event: add-to-cart / buy-now ----

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var btn = e.target.closest('.store-btn[data-action]');
        if (!btn) return;

        var actionsDiv = btn.closest('.store-lightbox-actions');
        if (!actionsDiv) return;

        var productId = actionsDiv.dataset.productId;
        if (!productId) return;

        var action = btn.dataset.action;
        var siblingBtns = actionsDiv.querySelectorAll('.store-btn');

        siblingBtns.forEach(function(b) { setLoading(b, true); });

        addToCart(productId)
            .then(function(data) {
                if (data.error) {
                    // OpenCart returns errors as object { warning: "...", option_N: "..." }
                    var errMsg = typeof data.error === 'string' ? data.error
                        : Array.isArray(data.error) ? data.error.join(', ')
                        : Object.values(data.error).join(', ');
                    throw new Error(errMsg);
                }

                if (action === 'buy-now') {
                    window.location.href = CHECKOUT_URL;
                    return;
                }

                // Restore Buy Now button; skip Add to Cart — go straight to Added
                siblingBtns.forEach(function(b) {
                    if (b !== btn) setLoading(b, false);
                });
                btn.style.transition = 'none';
                btn.classList.remove('store-btn-loading', 'store-btn-add-cart');
                btn.classList.add('store-btn-added');
                btn.textContent = 'Added \u2713';
                btn.style.backgroundColor = '#2e7d32'; // Force green (Safari fix)

                // Mark as added — persists across all slides
                addedProductIds[productId] = true;
                updateAddedStateForProduct(productId);

                // Immediately show tally (don't wait for fetchCart)
                miniCartState.cartCount = Math.max(miniCartState.cartCount, 0) + 1;
                activateTallyInAllTriggers();
                document.querySelectorAll('.store-cart-tally:not(.active)').forEach(function(tally) {
                    tally.classList.add('active');
                    var countEl = tally.querySelector('.store-cart-badge-count');
                    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = miniCartState.cartCount;
                    var textEl = tally.querySelector('.store-cart-badge-text');
                    if (textEl) textEl.textContent = ' item' + (miniCartState.cartCount !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' in cart';
                });
                startCaptionPoll();

                // Single fetch for both header badge AND exact cart count
                // (was two duplicate requests to the same endpoint — caused server queuing)
                fetchCart().then(function(cartData) {
                    miniCartState.cartCount = countCartItems(cartData);
                    updateAllTallies();
                    refreshHeaderBadge(cartData._raw);
                }).catch(function(err) {
                    console.warn('Store: post-add cart fetch failed', err.message);
                });
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                console.warn('Store: add-to-cart failed', err.message);
                siblingBtns.forEach(function(b) { setLoading(b, false); });
                btn.classList.add('store-btn-error');
                btn.textContent = 'Error';
                resetBtn(btn, 3000);
            });
    });
})();
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
    // Ken Burns — alternate zoom in / zoom out on both desktop + mobile slideshows
    function initKenBurns($slideshow) {
        var zoomIn = true;
        $slideshow.on('cycle-before', function(e, opts, outgoing, incoming){
            zoomIn = !zoomIn;
            $(incoming).css({opacity: 1, display: 'block', zIndex: 1});
            $(outgoing).css({zIndex: 2});
            $(incoming).addClass(zoomIn ? 'kb-in' : 'kb-out');
        });
        $slideshow.on('cycle-after', function(e, opts, outgoing, incoming){
            $(outgoing).removeClass('kb-in kb-out');
        });
    }
    initKenBurns($('#header-image .cycle-slideshow'));
    initKenBurns($('#mobile-header-image .cycle-slideshow'));

    // Initialize cycle with pager
    $('.cycle-slideshow').cycle({
        fx: 'fadeout',
        pager: '#carousel-pager',
        pagerTemplate: '<span></span>',
        pauseOnHover: true,
        timeout: 4000, // 4 seconds per slide (adjust as needed)
        speed: 2000 // transition speed — slow crossfade during Ken Burns
    });

    // Ken Burns — kick off first slide on both slideshows after init
    $('#header-image .cycle-slideshow img').first().addClass('kb-in');
    $('#mobile-header-image .cycle-slideshow img').first().addClass('kb-in');
    
    // Play/Pause toggle
    $('#carousel-play-pause').on('click', function() {
        var $icon = $(this).find('i');
        var $slideshow = $('.cycle-slideshow');
        
        if ($slideshow.is('.cycle-paused')) {
            // Currently paused, so play
            $slideshow.cycle('resume');
            $icon.removeClass('fa-play').addClass('fa-pause');
        } else {
            // Currently playing, so pause
            $slideshow.cycle('pause');
            $icon.removeClass('fa-pause').addClass('fa-play');
        }
    });
});
</script>

        if (!AUTO_FIX) return;
        
        $('.cycle-slideshow').each(function() {
            const $carousel = $(this);
            const isInitialized = !!$carousel.data('cycle.opts');
            
            if (!isInitialized && typeof $.fn.cycle !== 'undefined') {
